# `parallax.corr()` {#fn-parallax-corr}

A05 compared the returned correction with the signed spherical approximation in both hemispheres. [A05 results](a05-solar-limits.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-parallax-corr)

```{=html}
<p>The limiting-declination functions subtract this approximate correction from their
geocentric target. The correction in degrees is the supplied parallax multiplied by the
cosine of altitude and sine of latitude, with the angular arguments evaluated in
degrees. The sign therefore reverses between hemispheres. This scalar approximation is
distinct from computing an instantaneous topocentric ephemeris.
</p>
<p>Ruggles gives an archaeological example of applying mean lunar parallax in a
declination calculator.
</p>
```

</p>
